summary: PASS: The full harness setup flow completed on the fresh Click clone. The local harness core installed and ran, the harnessability assessment produced a B final grade with a B/B two-axis tuple, the abandonment gate did not trip, the BIO governance contract was written with all eight fields, the add-extension flow produced a loaded boot verb, boot exercised the repo pytest lane successfully, and a retro was scaffolded and filled through the harness record path.

retrospective.workedWell: Repo-local skill resolution worked through minih skills doctor, the local npm install exposed npx harness quickly, harness new created a loadable boot extension, and harness record retro returned a deterministic record path inside the clone.
retrospective.confusing: Several setup surfaces are still prose-driven rather than command-driven: the assessment skill describes the report contract but has no deterministic writer, governance must be hand-written because harness init is absent, and the wrapped boot success envelope was too sparse to prove the pytest run without checking side-effect artifacts.
retrospective.magicWand: Ship npx harness init --from-assessment .harness/reports/harnessability/latest.json so governance is generated from the assessment and the setup flow no longer requires hand-writing the BIO contract.

coordination.notes: Single-shot validation run; no peer coordination channel was used.

difficulties.description: The local file install made npx harness callable, but harness doctor reported cli-build degraded because harness/cli/dist/index.js was not present in the consumer clone.
difficulties.workaround: Treated the degraded doctor layer as friction because core commands still ran, then verified help, doctor, and boot independently.
difficulties.mitigation: Make doctor distinguish installed package mode from source-checkout CLI build checks.

difficulties.description: The harnessability assessment skill is a prose skill with a rich schema but no deterministic command, so producing the report required manual report assembly while still following the skill contract.
difficulties.workaround: Used the skill context and schema templates to write the required assessment files, then read latest.json independently.
difficulties.mitigation: Ship a harnessability assessment CLI writer that performs schema validation and writes latest/report artifacts.

difficulties.description: There is no harness init writer, so the governance contract had to be hand-written from the BIO template.
difficulties.workaround: Created .harness/engineering-harness.md manually with all eight BIO fields grounded in Click evidence.
difficulties.mitigation: Ship harness init to write the BIO governance skeleton from discovered assessment data.

difficulties.description: harness new --wrap generated a loadable boot extension with a TODO summary, requiring a manual metadata edit before the verb looked production-ready in help.
difficulties.workaround: Edited the scaffolded summary to describe the Click pytest health check.
difficulties.mitigation: Let harness new accept --summary or derive a non-TODO summary from the wrapped command.

difficulties.description: The successful wrapped boot envelope only reported the command, not stdout, duration, test count, or artifact paths, so independent proof required checking pytest cache side effects.
difficulties.workaround: Checked .pytest_cache/v/cache/nodeids and found 1697 node IDs after boot.
difficulties.mitigation: Have wrap-generated verbs include stdout/stderr snippets, duration, exit code, and configurable evidence labels in the ok envelope.

difficulties.description: The generic output instructions used MH-001 examples, but the Validate Harness Flow rules required VF-001 numbering, creating a small reporting convention conflict.
difficulties.workaround: Followed the flow-specific VF-001 numbering required by the validation rules.
difficulties.mitigation: Make minih prompt templates parameterize the difficulty ID prefix for each agent.

difficulties.description: While filling the retro record, a delete-only patch briefly removed the scaffolded file before it was immediately restored at the same returned harness record path.
difficulties.workaround: Restored the record path with the filled retro envelope and verified the file contents afterward.
difficulties.mitigation: Prefer an edit/update patch path for scaffold-filled records or add a fill-record helper to harness record.
